svg.aria-label: Every model I have ever built started the same way: a messy dataset and a question nobody had time to answer. So I learned to answer them end to end — not just the notebook and the accuracy score, but the pipeline feeding it, the API standing in front of it, and the container it ships inside. Then the models started talking back. LLMs, retrieval, agents that choose their own tools. I have been building there ever since: an autonomous analyst that turns raw tables into business intelligence, a translator that turns plain English into SQL, a multi-agent desk that reads the market while I sleep. The thread has never changed — take something raw and unreadable, and hand back something a person can actually act on.
